notes.title: The Clowns are back, 1 year anniversary update is coming soon!
notes.content: [p]                           [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229827/2b0cbbec9f73ff509f8ef26388086613bfea0ff9.png"][/img][/p][h1]Get ready to s&@t your pants![/h1][p][/p][h3]After being live for a year already! We are excited to announce a massive 1 year anniversary update for free! Featuring a whole new gameplay experience!  What's coming? Well look no further, take a peak below and find out! [/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]A brand new carnival map that's  interactive! [/p][/*][*][p]New mini-games added to the game modes to make it a littler more challenging![/p][/*][*][p]Restore power system to help track down those balloons![/p][/*][*][p]New more advanced clowns that add a whole new fear factor! [/p][/*][*][p]Characters overhaul and movement update! [/p][/*][*][p]New jump scares![/p][/*][*][p]Revive system! [/p][/*][*][p]User Interface update![/p][/*][*][p]Holiday Editions! [/p][/*][*][p]And a secret addition that we won't announce just yet ;) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Coming October 2025[/h1]
